## Source functions


## Read Encoding & Recall Datasets

```{r read data, echo=FALSE}
# set working directory
path = dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
setwd(path)

# read encoding and free recall data
baytour_recall_data_raw <- read_csv("event_baytour_recall.csv")
encoding_data <- read_csv("encoding_data.csv")
```

## Data transformation: recall data

```{r recall data transformation}
# transform data into long format
baytour_recall_data <- baytour_recall_data_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(6:23), values_to = "item_num") %>% 
  select(`Subject ID`, `Tour Section (H/P)`, "item_num") %>%
  mutate(subject_id = `Subject ID`, block = `Tour Section (H/P)`) %>%  
  select(subject_id, block, item_num) %>%
  group_by(subject_id, block) %>%
  mutate(recall_position = row_number()) %>% # original order of items 
  filter(!(block == "P" & recall_position > 13)) %>% # block "P" has 13 recall space
  mutate(block_recode = 
           case_when(block == "H" ~ 1,
                     block == "P" ~ 2)) # recode block to numeric value

# View(baytour_recall_data)
```

```{r checking duplicates}
# Check for duplicates within subject and block
duplicates <- baytour_recall_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(item_num)) %>%  # remove NA item_nums first
  group_by(subject_id, block) %>%
  mutate(duplicate = duplicated(item_num) | duplicated(item_num, fromLast = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(duplicate) %>%
  arrange(subject_id, block, item_num)

print(duplicates)
```

## Exclude participants with fewer than 5 order-tagged recall items (4 transitions)

```{r trial exclusion}
# list out the ids 
baytour_exclude_trial <- list()
counter <- 1

# count trials within each block for each participant
for (each_subject in unique(baytour_recall_data$subject_id)) {
  # compute the block number
  max_block = unique(baytour_recall_data$block[baytour_recall_data$subject_id == each_subject])
  # count the item_num in each block within each participant
  for(each_block in max_block) {
    n_items <- sum(!is.na(baytour_recall_data$item_num[baytour_recall_data$subject_id == each_subject & baytour_recall_data$block == each_block]))
    if (n_items < 5) {
      baytour_exclude_trial[[counter]] <- list(subject = each_subject, block = each_block)
      counter <- counter + 1
    }
  # print out how many recall items each subject has
  # print(paste("Subject:", each_subject, "has", n_items, "items"))
  }
}

# Convert each list element into a data frame row and then bind all rows together
exclusion_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(baytour_exclude_trial, function(x) {
  data.frame(subject_id = x$subject, block = x$block, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))
exclusion_df

# exclude participants
baytour_recall_data_clean <- anti_join(baytour_recall_data, exclusion_df, by = c("subject_id", "block"))
```

## Combine clean recall and encoding

```{r combine datasets}
complete_baytour_data <- recall_binding(encoding_data, baytour_recall_data_clean)
complete_baytour_data  <- complete_baytour_data %>%
  mutate(block_recode = case_when(
    block == "H" ~ 1, 
    block == "P" ~ 2
  ))
```

## Event Label: Create event transition label for recall data

```{r add event label}
zone_based_data <- zone_based_category(complete_recall_transition)
```

# Overall distance check

## Encoding
```{r create event types for encoding data}
event_encoding_data <- zone_based_encoding(encoding_data)
```

```{r select non-repetitive trials}
items_data <- event_encoding_data %>%
  distinct(block, item_num, event_transition, abs_lag_distance)
```

```{r summarise distance}
items_data %>%
  group_by(event_transition) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_distance = mean(abs_lag_distance),
    sd_distance = sd(abs_lag_distance),
    median_distance = median(abs_lag_distance)
  )
```

```{r welch t test}
t.test(
  abs_lag_distance ~ event_transition,
  data = items_data
)
```

## Recall 
```{r distance calculation for lags between event categories}
# check assumptions
dfSummary(zone_based_data$abs_lag_distance)
skewness(zone_based_data$abs_lag_distance, na.rm= TRUE)

# create absolute temporal lag column
zone_distance_constrained <- zone_based_data %>% 
  mutate(abs_lags = abs(actual_lags)) %>%
  filter(abs_lags <= 3) %>% # apply temporal constraints
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  ungroup
```

```{r mixed linear regression}
# mixed linear regression to check distance between recalled item pairs
lag_distance_model <- lmer(abs_lag_distance ~ event_transition * factor(abs_lags) + (1 | subject_id), data = zone_distance_constrained)

summary(lag_distance_model)

emm <- emmeans(
  lag_distance_model,
  ~ event_transition | abs_lags
)
emm
pairs(emm)
plot(emm)
```
*Note* Recalled items from within the same event were spatially closer than items recalled across events. But this was not the case for the physical distance between item pairs.

# Additional Analysis

## Distance check for temporal factor
```{r}
# collapse over ptile and lag column
common_deno_combine_ptile <- common_deno_recall_ptile  %>%
  mutate(
    abs_actual_lag = coalesce(
      abs_actual_lags_within,
      abs_actual_lags_between
    ),
    ptile_rank = coalesce(
      ptile_rank_within,
      ptile_rank_between
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(abs_actual_lag < 4) # apply a temporal restriction to match temporal lag distance between within vs. between

# center distance mean
common_deno_combine_ptile <- common_deno_combine_ptile %>%
  mutate(
    abs_lag_distance_c =
      abs_lag_distance - mean(abs_lag_distance, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


# mixed linear model
distance_lmer_model <- lmer(ptile_rank ~ abs_lag_distance_c + event_transition + (1 | subject_id), data = common_deno_combine_ptile)
summary(distance_lmer_model)

distance_interaction_model <- lmer(ptile_rank ~ abs_lag_distance_c * event_transition + (1 | subject_id), data = common_deno_combine_ptile
)
summary(distance_interaction_model)


# BIC-based model comparison
distance_lmer_model %>%
  BIC
distance_interaction_model  %>%
  BIC
log_bayes_factor = abs(BIC(distance_lmer_model) - BIC(distance_interaction_model ))
log_bayes_factor %>%
  print

library(emmeans)

emtrends(
  distance_interaction_model,
  pairwise ~ event_transition,
  var = "abs_lag_distance_c"
)

emmeans(
  distance_interaction_model,
  pairwise ~ event_transition,
  at = list(abs_lag_distance_c = c(-3, 0, 3))
)
```

```{r}

# Select representative centered lag distances
lag_values <- seq(
  min(common_deno_combine_ptile$abs_lag_distance_c, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(common_deno_combine_ptile$abs_lag_distance_c, na.rm = TRUE),
  length.out = 20
)

# Estimated marginal means
emm_lag <- emmeans(
  distance_interaction_model,   # replace with your model-object name
  ~ event_transition | abs_lag_distance_c,
  at = list(abs_lag_distance_c = lag_values)
)

emm_df <- as.data.frame(emm_lag)


# Plot
ggplot(
  emm_df,
  aes(
    x = abs_lag_distance_c,
    y = emmean,
    colour = event_transition,
    fill = event_transition
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
    alpha = 0.15,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute euclidean distance between items (mean-centred)",
    y = "Estimated percentile rank",
    colour = "Event transition",
    fill = "Event transition"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )

```
